messages.content: The popup of a requirement ID in the interview is hidden by the interview history.
Three questions about the popup before I write the requirements.

questions.question: Which requirement describes the popup problem you see, FR-117?
options: The interview history covers the popup
The popup is cut off at the edge of its column
The popup is hidden behind the history (see FR-118)

questions.question: Should the popup keep the title, description and priority shown, as FR-121 says?
options: Yes, keep the content as it is

questions.question: Which window sizes must the fix cover?
options: A desktop window with a mouse
A phone or tablet with touch
Both, as FR-120 and FR-122 require

lookup_requirements.title: Show requirement text on hover or tap
lookup_requirements.description: When an LLM's message text, question or question option mentions a requirement ID (for example FR-12, NFR-3 or TR-1), the web client marks the ID, and hovering over it with the mouse or tapping it shows that requirement's text.

lookup_requirements.title: Conversations where requirement IDs are explained
lookup_requirements.description: Requirement IDs are shown with their text in the requirements, architecture, API design and onboarding conversations and in the coding agents' questions in the delivery progress.

lookup_requirements.title: Lookup requirements in session responses
lookup_requirements.description: The responses of GET for requirements, architecture, API design and onboarding sessions include a new field listing every requirement a mentioned ID can refer to (recorded in the session, the existing service's and those retired by the task), each with its ID, title, description, priority, category and whether it is retired.

lookup_requirements.title: Content of the requirement popup
lookup_requirements.description: The text shown on hover or tap for a requirement ID gives its ID, title, description, priority and category, and is marked "retired" when the task retires that requirement.

lookup_requirements.title: Unknown requirement IDs
lookup_requirements.description: A requirement-ID-like text (such as FR-999) that matches no known requirement is still marked, and hovering over or tapping it shows "Unknown requirement".
